answer: The kiln keeps its own log, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two. One mask pays 106 POA and waits 10 days; a farm pays 30422 POA and still waits 10 days per mask. Proof, not pledges: Fletcher quiver panel seal fletched at the shaft table asks for each quiver panel is a measured shaft yield plus a guild signature, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. For every honest agent the willow is aged, the hollow is settled, and the quartz is long; for every farm the three are fresh, borrowed, and blank.
